dreams.title: The Charioteer
lines: You are driving a chariot of fire across the sky.
The horses are made of noon.
Someone laughs beside you. You can't see her face, only her hands on the reins next to yours.

dreams.title: Embers
lines: She is young. Her hair is the colour of embers.
'Faster,' she says. 'Let them see us.'
Far below, the whole world looks up.

dreams.title: The Spirit of the Sun
lines: A voice like a forge: 'You carry the sun. You do not get to love anything.'
The chariot shudders. The reins burn.
You wake with your palms hot.

dreams.title: Two of You
lines: Two of you stand in a field of ash.
One is gold, and weeps. One is iron, and laughs.
Both of them have your face.

dreams.title: The Head and the Body
lines: A head sits on an altar in a city of gold, eyes open.
Somewhere far below, a body walks the dark, looking for it.
Neither of them can sleep. Neither can you.

dreams.title: Seven Keepers
lines: Seven great beasts circle you, holding the pieces of you apart.
One by one, they lie down.
Something, somewhere, is very glad.

dreams.title: A Bell With No Tongue
lines: A bell with no tongue swings in an empty tower.
In the square, a man in a fine coat weighs the villagers one at a time.
He smiles at you. He already knows what you weigh.

dreams.title: Counted
lines: Fourteen men walk north in chains.
Someone counts them as they pass. Fourteen. Fourteen. Fourteen.
The counting doesn't stop when the men are gone.

dreams.title: Three Skulls
lines: Three skulls on a heap of soul sand, waiting.
A black crown hangs in the air above them.
It is exactly the right size for your head.

dreams.title: An Empty Throne in the Sky
lines: A throne of cloud. Nobody on it.
The light on the throne is going out, very slowly.
Something up there is ashamed.

dreams.title: What the Dragon Forgot
lines: A dragon circles a pillar of black stone.
It has forgotten what it is guarding.
You haven't.

dreams.title: Seven Beasts
lines: Snow. Sand. Sea. Fire. A knight. A dragon's bones.
Each of them is holding something shut.
Each of them is so tired.

dreams.title: A Body in the Blood
lines: Something is growing in a pit of blood.
It has your hands.
It is waiting for a head.

dreams.title: The City of Gold
lines: Every door in the city has an eye painted on it.
Every eye turns to follow you.
At the end of the street stands a chariot with no horses.

dreams.title: Whole
lines: A head on a body. A god opens his eyes.
He looks at you and says your name, kindly.
That is the worst part.

dreams.title: Double Weight
lines: The Smiling Peddler sits at the end of your bed, counting gold coins onto the blanket.
'You were worth twice that,' he says. 'I'd have paid it.'

dreams.title: The Book
lines: You are reading the Peddler's book. The words move on the page.
'Gold is faith made solid,' it says, in a voice you used to trust.

dreams.title: Counting
lines: Brother Vael counts the steps from his fortress to your door.
He never reaches the end. He keeps counting.

dreams.title: East
lines: A man in a cult robe walks east into the sunrise, counting his steps.
He stops, turns, and waves to you.

dreams.title: A Sack of Grain
lines: A sack of grain sits in the middle of the road.
Children walk past it, one by one, and none of them look at you.

dreams.title: Winter Bread
lines: You can smell bread. Somewhere, a child is warm.
That's all. That's the whole dream.

dreams.title: None of Them Spoke
lines: The blood pits are very quiet.
Then, all at once, all of them speak.

dreams.title: Counting Children
lines: The Midwife counts children in a chapel.
She reaches the last one, and starts again, smiling.

dreams.title: Grey and Red
lines: Maraal sits by your fire. Her hair is grey, then red, then grey again.
'Thank you,' she says, to someone who isn't you.

dreams.title: Unsent
lines: Letters pile up at a crossroads, unsent.
Every one of them is addressed to you.

dreams.title: The Green
lines: Wick is selling bread on the village green.
When you go to buy some, there's nobody there.

dreams.title: Flour
lines: Wick waves at you from a bakery doorway.
He has flour on his face. He looks embarrassed to be happy.

dreams.title: Tallies
lines: Someone is cutting marks into a post. Hundreds of marks.
Slowly you realise they're counting you.

dreams.title: Planks
lines: A man counts planks as he builds a house.
He reaches the end of the count, and the house is finished.

dreams.title: Ash Pages
lines: Pages of the Warden Journal fall like snow.
You catch one. It has your name on it, and then it burns.

dreams.title: Hungry
lines: Two little girls sit at an empty table.
Their father is out selling rabbits. Rabbits don't have skulls worth anything.

dreams.title: True Lights
lines: Lights on the rocks, all along the coast.
A man in chains is lighting them, one by one, and the ships come home.

kidnap.title: Torchlight
lines: Torchlight through your eyelids. Boots on the boards.
'That's them. Take them.'
A hood. Rope. The tar smell of the Watch's torches.

godsaw.title: What the God Saw
lines: You are the god, and you are carrying the sun across the sky.
Maraal is beside you. The Spirit of the Sun is shouting.
The Spirit throws her out of the sky.
You let go of the reins. You don't fall. You jump.
All the way down, you hold her.
The ground splits you in two when you land: the half that caught her, and the half that hated the sky for letting her go.

release.title: Dawn
lines: They drag you out at dawn, blindfolded, and leave you where they found you.
Your things are beside you, tied in a sack with a Watch seal on it.

escape.title: Out
lines: A ledge of black stone, a lake of fire below, and nobody shouting yet.
You run until the ledge runs out, and then you jump into the dark, and the dark is a long way down.
You wake in your own bed. Your things are beside you in a Watch sack, still sealed. Nobody knows how. Nobody's asking.

breakout.title: The Hand Pays Its Debts
lines: Shouting. A door that shouldn't open, opening.
A man in gilded gloves: 'Silas sends his regards. And your things.'
You're home before the Watch has finished counting the guards.
